description.narrative: This proposal outlines the collaborative initiative between UNESCO and Talkmate to advance linguistic diversity, multilingual education, and language technology. In an increasingly interconnected world, linguistic diversity is both a cultural treasure and a resource for fostering mutual understanding and innovation. However, globalization, digitalization, and socio-economic shifts have posed significant threats to the survival of many languages, particularly those of Indigenous and underrepresented communities. This project aims to safeguard and promote linguistic diversity through a comprehensive approach that leverages language technology solutions, policy advocacy, and community engagement. It will focus on organizing a language technology event and strengthening the capacities of different stakeholders to make use and develop technologies. It will also advocate for the upscaling of the Yuelu Declaration and prepare a groundwork to support the establishment of a national language museum in China. Key strategies include facilitating multilingual networks, promoting digital tools for language preservation, and supporting AI-driven language learning platforms. The project is set to conclude in August 2026, ensuring a sustainable impact on linguistic diversity preservation and policy enhancement globally.
